Fix: made `gc` and `weakref` native dynamic-build modules (`BUILTIN_MODULES`, `module_has`, `module_call`). Added `src/dynpy/rt_gc.rs` (included in the runtime) implementing:
- `weakref.ref` as a native `Ext` value holding `Rc::downgrade` weak pointers (for objects, classes, functions, bound methods, sets/frozensets) with `__call__`, `__callback__`, and best-effort callbacks.
- `gc.collect` as a conservative cycle collector: it walks the value graph reachable from every live weakref target (including dict entries/index, views, dict iterators, lists, sets, tuples, deques, object attrs/inner), uses strong counts vs. walked in-degrees to find nodes with no outside references, and clears only garbage containers. Missing/untraversable edges make nodes look reachable, so the collector never frees a live value.
- Mutable containers are emptied by moving contents out and dropping them after the RefCell borrow is released, so no user code runs under a held borrow.

Tested: `check_test` now matches CPython on both normal and forced dynamic builds. Also verified nearby cases with try_python: live objects survive collect, self/dict/set/view/iterator cycles clear, `weakref.ref` accepts weakrefable builtins and rejects non-weakrefable ones with TypeError, and weakref callbacks fire (including cyclic garbage during gc.collect).
